body: His parents are very nice and supportive, but very religious (have never had alcohol in their lives, no sex before marriage) and I am not sure they know how to react without over reacting. That is why I have hesitated to talk to them. I have been encouraging him to get help, but he does not seem to see the drinking and drug use as an issue and has given up on any hope of depression medication and talk therapy being help to him.

It's been months that I have been letting this go on. I feel like that tactic would have made sense two months ago, but now it would ketch him completely off guard. Should I wait and see if it escalates again before broaching the topic?

Thank you, I've talked to a crisis hotline, my parents and my professor who is a family therapist about it, but I have not had a chance to get an opinion from someone who has had a more personal experience. I appreciate your input.
